transcript: Speaker A: I Wash. Wash means clean with water. I use soap and water. I Wipe. Wipe means clean with a cloth. I move my hand like this. I Mop. Mop means clean with water and a mop. The floor becomes wet. I Clean. Clean means make something not dirty. I make it neat. I Sweep. Sweep means clean with a broom. I move dust together, all clean. I Fix. Fix means repair. I make it work again. I Dust. Dust means remove dust. I clean small dirt. I Arrange. Arrange means put things in order. I place them nicely. I Organize. Organize means make things neat and clear. Everything has a place. I Fold. Fold means make clothes smaller and neat. I use my hands.
